# opnsense_bind_record (Resource)

Manages a record in a BIND zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_bind_record" "ns1_address" {
  domain_id = opnsense_bind_primary_domain.public.id
  name      = "ns1"
  type      = "A"
  value     = "192.0.2.53"
}

resource "opnsense_bind_record" "ns1" {
  domain_id = opnsense_bind_primary_domain.public.id
  name      = "@"
  type      = "NS"
  value     = "ns1.example.net."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) UUID of the BIND zone.
- `type` (String) DNS record type.
- `value` (String) Record value in BIND presentation format.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `name` (String) Relative record owner name. Use @ for the zone apex.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the record.
